> # Implementation Plan: Transforming Vigil into an Open-Source Hark Pro
>
> ## Overview
>
> This plan defines the complete visual design system, frontend component architecture, and backend engineering blueprint required to evolve **Vigil** into an open-source counterpart to **Hark Pro**. Every specification below is mapped directly to existing files in `web/src/` and `backend/src/`.
>
> ---
>
> ## Part I: Hark Pro Design System Specification (UI/UX & Visual Tokens)
>
> Hark Pro's industrial design direction (led by former Apple industrial designer Abidur Chowdhury) combines **warm, tactile materiality** with **ambient low-arousal clarity**. It rejects generic AI tropes (neon purple/cyan gradients, cartoon mascots, raw terminal dumps, and chat-bubble clutter) in favor of an **Operating System GUI** built from continuous squircle surfaces, crisp specular borders, and verb-driven interactions.
>
> ### 1. Color Composition & Surface Palette (`web/src/styles/tokens.css`)
>
> We refine Vigil's dual-theme palette into **Obsidian Horizon (Dark)** and **Tactile Alabaster (Light)**, introducing explicit tokens for **Proactivity Tags**, **Verb Pills**, **Approval Surfaces**, and **Specular Rim Highlights**.
>
> #### Dark Theme (`[data-theme='dark']` — "Obsidian Horizon")
> | Token | Value | Purpose & Visual Role |
> | :--- | :--- | :--- |
> | `--bg-from` | `#06070A` | Deep obsidian upper canvas ground |
> | `--bg-to` | `#0C0F17` | Midnight slate lower canvas ground |
> | `--surface-solid` | `#11151F` | Opaque modal, sheet, and elevated widget base |
> | `--card` | `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.045)` | Translucent primary card surface |
> | `--card-hover` | `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07)` | Elevated hover state for interactive cards |
> | `--card-strong` | `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.095)` | Active/expanded card or nested widget tile |
> | `--border` | `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)` | Hairline structural border (`1px solid`) |
> | `--border-strong` | `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18)` | Focused, active, or emphasized border |
> | `--rim-highlight` | `inset 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12)` | Top-edge Apple-style specular glass catchlight |
> | `--text` | `#F5F7FA` | Primary editorial ink (96% white to prevent halation) |
> | `--text-secondary` | `rgba(245, 247, 250, 0.72)` | Card summaries, secondary descriptions |
> | `--text-muted` | `rgba(245, 247, 250, 0.48)` | Timestamps, metadata, inactive labels |
> | `--btn-primary-bg` | `#F5F7FA` | Primary Verb Button surface |
> | `--btn-primary-ink` | `#080A0F` | Primary Verb Button typography |
> | `--hark-amber` | `#E88449` | Warm dawn accent (`✦` proactivity spark, active beam) |
> | `--hark-amber-soft` | `rgba(232, 132, 73, 0.14)` | Proactivity tag fill & approval card ambient wash |
> | `--hark-amber-border`| `rgba(232, 132, 73, 0.32)` | Proactivity tag & approval checkpoint border |
> | `--status-approve` | `#34D399` | Approved state / verified vault indicator |
> | `--status-urgent` | `#F97316` | Critical/high urgency 3px left rail |
> | `--status-danger` | `#F43F5E` | Destructive action / rejected state |
> | `--cloud-1` | `rgba(232, 132, 73, 0.11)` | Upper-left warm dawn atmospheric drift |
> | `--cloud-2` | `rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.06)` | Upper-right cool stratosphere drift |
> | `--cloud-3` | `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03)` | Lower-right subtle ambient glow |
>
> #### Light Theme (`[data-theme='light']` — "Tactile Alabaster")
> | Token | Value | Purpose & Visual Role |
> | :--- | :--- | :--- |
> | `--bg-from` | `#FAF8F5` | Warm paper ivory upper canvas |
> | `--bg-to` | `#F0ECE1` | Soft sand/stone lower canvas |
> | `--surface-solid` | `#FFFFFF` | Crisp white elevated sheet and micro-app frame |

> | `--border-strong` | `rgba(24, 24, 27, 0.18)` | Active/focused border |

>
> ### 2. Typography & Sizing Scale
> All typography uses self-hosted **`Plus Jakarta Sans Variable`** (`--font-sans`) with `font-feature-settings: "cv02", "cv03", "cv04", "cv11"` for geometric legibility, paired with system monospace (`ui-monospace, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace`) for code, diffs, and tool parameters.
>
> ### 3. Spatial Architecture, Radii & Squircle Geometry
> - **Dashboard Panel / Micro-App Frame**: `24px` (`rounded-[24px]`), Width `100%`, Height `380px–560px`, `var(--shadow)`, `1px solid var(--border)`, `var(--rim-highlight)`
> - **Proactivity Task Card**: `20px` (`rounded-[20px]`), Min-height `68px`, Padding `16px 20px`
> - **Inline Approval Card**: `18px` (`rounded-[18px]`), Width `100%` (`max-w-2xl`), Padding `16px 18px`, `1px solid var(--hark-amber-border)`, bg `var(--hark-amber-soft)`
> - **Floating Input Composer (`InputPill`)**: `26px` (`rounded-[26px]`), Min-height `54px`, Max-width `672px`
> - **Primary & Secondary Verb Buttons**: `9999px` (`rounded-full`), Height `34px` (cards) / `38px` (modals), Padding `0 16px`
> - **Proactivity Observation Pill**: `9999px` (`rounded-full`), Height `24px`, Padding `0 10px`
>
> ### 4. Motion Physics & Spring Constants
> Replace `cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1)` in `web/src/styles/tokens.css` with the 17-point CSS `linear()` spring curve:
> ```css
> @theme {
>   --ease-spring: linear(
>     0, 0.009, 0.035 2.1%, 0.141, 0.281 6.7%, 0.723 12.9%, 0.938 16.7%,
>     1.017, 1.028 21.8%, 1.018 26%, 1.003 33.2%, 0.999 45%, 1
>   );
> }
> ```
>
> ---
>
> ## Part II: UI Component Specifications & Visual Anatomy
>
> 1. **Decommissioning the Companion Mascot (`<EyeTracker />`)**:
>    - `web/src/components/layout/HeaderBrand.tsx`: Remove `<EyeTracker />`; render minimalist `Vigil ✦` lockup (16px 4-point vector spark with 4s opacity pulse).
>    - `web/src/routes/LandingRoute.tsx`: Remove `<EyeTracker />` from navbar and hero; showcase Hark-style Proactivity Cards, Micro-App Panel, and Inline Approval Checkpoint.
>    - `web/src/styles/tokens.css`: Remove `.eyt*` rules.
> 2. **Proactivity Tags & Verb-Based Action Cards**:

>    - `backend/src/modules/triage/service.py`: Replace hardcoded `"Quick Reply"` and `"Mark Done"` with intent-aware Proactivity Tags (`✦ Michael wants to book an email`) and active verb buttons (`Draft`, `Book`, `Pay`, `RSVP`).
>    - `web/src/components/ui/NotificationCard.tsx` & `web/src/components/home/TaskCard.tsx`: Render `proactivityTag` pill badge, 3px urgency left rail, auto-open high/critical/approval cards, and style verb buttons.
> 3. **Inline Human-in-the-Loop Approval Checkpoints (`InlineApprovalCard.tsx`)**:
>    - Create `web/src/components/chat/InlineApprovalCard.tsx` consuming `useApprovals('pending')` and `useDecideApproval()`.
>    - Update `web/src/components/chat/ThinkingCapsule.tsx` and `web/src/routes/ChatRoute.tsx` to render `<InlineApprovalCard />` inline instead of the broken `/agent/approvals` link.
> 4. **Sandboxed Micro-App Showcase & Pinned Dashboard Panels**:
>    - `web/src/components/chat/ArtifactCard.tsx`: Render interactive `<iframe sandbox="allow-scripts allow-forms" srcDoc={...} />` with `[ Preview | Code ]` toggle, viewport size switcher (`375px` / `768px` / `100%`), and `[ 📌 Pin to Home ]`.
>    - `web/src/components/home/WidgetsRail.tsx`: Render pinned Micro-App Panels on the Home dashboard.
>    - `backend/src/modules/runs/tools/delivery.py` & `backend/src/modules/artifacts/router.py`: Add `deliver_site` tool and `GET /api/v1/artifacts/{artifact_id}/site/{filepath:path}` static asset server.
>
> ---
>
> ## Part III: Pluggable MCP Factory Pattern & Dynamic Tool Registry
>
> 1. **`backend/src/integrations/mcp/factory.py`**:
>    - `MCPTransportProtocol`, `StdioMCPTransport` (with Vault secret env injection), `SseMCPTransport` (with Vault header injection), `MCPPresetSpec`, `MCP_PRESETS` (`firecrawl`, `github`, `filesystem`, `postgres`, `linear`), and `MCPTransportFactory`.
> 2. **`backend/src/modules/runs/tools/mcp_bridge.py`**:
>    - `MCPToolAdapterFactory` wrapping `MCPDiscoveredToolDTO` into executable Vigil `Tool` instances.
> 3. **`backend/src/modules/runs/service.py`**:
>    - Inject dynamic MCP tools and approval levels into `build_loop()` and `PartitionPolicy`.
>
> ---
>
> ## Part IV: Cloud Browser (Firecrawl), Groq Whisper STT, & Vault Backend
>
> 1. **`backend/src/modules/runs/tools/browser.py`**:
>    - Implement `browser_navigate` and `browser_extract` using Firecrawl API (`FIRECRAWL_API_KEY` from Vault or settings) + screenshot artifacts.
> 2. **`backend/src/modules/voice/router.py` & `web/src/components/chat/InputPill.tsx`**:
>    - Implement `POST /api/v1/voice/transcribe` powered by Groq `whisper-large-v3-turbo` (`GROQ_API_KEY`), registered in `backend/src/config/router.py`.

- (a) Provide fallback/mock modes so all features and automated tests pass without requiring external API keys
- (b) Require active API keys and live external endpoints
- (c) OPEN (let the team decide)
*Default: (a) Provide fallback/mock modes so all features and automated tests pass without requiring external API keys*

5. **Verification Resources**

- (b) Custom verification script or commands (please specify)

Define visual tokens for proactivity tags, verb pills, approval surfaces, specular rim highlights (`inset 0 1px 0 0 ...`), Plus Jakarta Sans typography scale (`--font-sans`), squircle geometry radii (`24px`, `20px`, `18px`, `26px`, `rounded-full`), and the 17-point CSS `linear()` spring curve (`--ease-spring`).

### R2. UI Component Architecture & Mascot Decommissioning
Decommission the `<EyeTracker />` companion mascot from `web/src/components/layout/HeaderBrand.tsx`, `web/src/routes/LandingRoute.tsx`, and `web/src/styles/tokens.css`, replacing it with the minimalist `Vigil ✦` vector spark brand mark. Extend backend schemas (`backend/src/modules/cards/data.py`, `backend/src/schemas/triage.py`) and triage service (`backend/src/modules/triage/service.py`) to generate proactivity tags and active verbs. Update `NotificationCard.tsx` and `TaskCard.tsx` to display proactivity tags, 3px urgency rails, and styled verb action buttons. Implement an extensible MCP transport protocol and factory in `backend/src/integrations/mcp/factory.py` supporting stdio (with vault environment variable injection) and SSE transports (with vault header injection), along with presets for firecrawl, github, filesystem, postgres, and linear. Implement `MCPToolAdapterFactory` in `backend/src/modules/runs/tools/mcp_bridge.py` to adapt discovered MCP tools into Vigil's runtime tool registry and execution loop in `backend/src/modules/runs/service.py`, respecting partition approval policies.

Implement `browser_navigate` and `browser_extract` tools in `backend/src/modules/runs/tools/browser.py` powered by Firecrawl API with screenshot artifact creation and fallback mocks when unconfigured. Implement `POST /api/v1/voice/transcribe` in `backend/src/modules/voice/router.py` powered by Groq `whisper-large-v3-turbo` with fallback mock handling, and connect client-side `MediaRecorder` in `web/src/components/chat/InputPill.tsx` to automatically populate composer text. - [ ] Dark (`[data-theme='dark']`) and Light (`[data-theme='light']`) CSS tokens in `web/src/styles/tokens.css` define all specified Hark Pro colors, specular rim catchlights, Plus Jakarta Sans font features, squircle radii, and the 17-point CSS linear spring easing.

### Action Cards & Inline Approvals
- [ ] Backend triage service and card schemas produce `proactivity_tag` and active `verb` fields.
- [ ] `TaskCard.tsx` and `NotificationCard.tsx` render proactivity tag badges, 3px urgency left rails, and primary/secondary verb action buttons.
- [ ] `InlineApprovalCard.tsx` renders inline within chat streams and handles decision actions (approve/reject) without redirecting to `/agent/approvals`.
- [ ] `ArtifactCard.tsx` renders sandboxed iframe previews with preview/code toggle, viewport width switcher, and home dashboard pinning that displays in `WidgetsRail.tsx`.

### MCP Factory & Dynamic Tool Registry
- [ ] `MCPTransportFactory` instantiates stdio and SSE transports with credential injection from the vault and supports presets for firecrawl, github, filesystem, postgres, and linear.
- [ ] Discovered MCP tools are dynamically converted into Vigil `Tool` instances and integrated into the execution loop with approval partitioning.

### Browser, Voice & Vault Integrations
- [ ] Firecrawl-based `browser_navigate` and `browser_extract` tools are registered and functional, producing artifacts on screenshots.
- [ ] `POST /api/v1/voice/transcribe` endpoint handles audio transcription via Groq Whisper and seamlessly binds to `InputPill.tsx` voice recording.
- [ ] Fallback/mock mechanisms are active when `FIRECRAWL_API_KEY` or `GROQ_API_KEY` are unset, allowing test suites to succeed.
- [ ] Settings connectors view includes the AES-256-GCM API Key Vault management, MCP preset gallery, and custom server registration.

### Quality & Test Suite
- [ ] Frontend type checking and build pass cleanly without errors.
- [ ] Backend test suite (`pytest`) passes cleanly.
